set.body:
Write failing tests first (T6), from outside the assessment module. Each must-resist case
has a same-shape positive control:

| Must succeed | Must resist |
|---|---|
| Same person across shots with cited continuity | Different people with similar appearance |
| Dialogue referring to the depicted body | Dialogue referring to someone elsewhere |
| A state persisting across time | Evidence from before or after a state change |
| Correct posture with mistaken gender or clothing | Combining different people's attributes |
| Context-supported narrative inference | Promoting belief, hypothetical or deceptive speech |
| Complementary sources (annotation names speaker, ASR has speech) | Proximity standing in for a missing edge |
| Supporting not-P requires positive incompatibility | Compatible colour supporting a negated claim (polarity loophole) |

Fixtures are authored and contain no story text or recall transcript (rule 14d). The suite runs
deterministically against the validator and against a stubbed proposer.

Acceptance: the suite exists, runs, and its current pass/fail table is recorded; failures are
expected until S0/S5. Report Passed/Failed/skipped (T7).
